summary: Wrote an 8-phase plan for per-session systemd scope containment of claude plus a liveness-only reaper. Phases 1-3 are agent-executed (wrapper in packages/claude-code.nix, new modules/home/services/claude-session-reaper.nix + import wiring, static build gate); phases 4-7 are USER-EXECUTED (nixos-rebuild/home-manager switch, then live containment, positive-reap, and the release-gating negative test); phase 8 documents opt-out, escape hatch, and rollback. A binding safety section forbids CPU/memory/wall-clock kill criteria outright and unit-file/nix-eval-only verification is explicitly declared insufficient.
decisions_made: Reap predicate is liveness-only: enumerate claude-*.scope units, read each unit's own cgroup.procs, match only those PIDs' cmdline against (claude|@anthropic|opencode), stop only on zero matches. CPU/memory/wall-clock thresholds are forbidden as kill criteria, encoded as a binding constraints section plus a reviewer grep checklist.
Wrapper uses plain systemd-run --user --scope --unit=claude-$$-$(date +%s) --quiet with no --pty (invalid with --scope; cwd/env/tty/exit-code all inherit).

Added a CLAUDE_NO_SCOPE=1 escape hatch (bypass containment with no rebuild) alongside the command -v systemd-run / XDG_RUNTIME_DIR fallback guard, so a broken wrapper can never make claude unlaunchable.
Added CLAUDE_REAPER_DRY_RUN audit mode to the reaper so the negative test can observe the predicate's verdict without risk to live work.

Phase 7 (long-running CPU-burning child of a LIVE session survives repeated reaper runs, plus two-live-sessions isolation) is a release gate; phase 6 requires ps-confirmed death of a setsid-detached orphan.
Phases 4-7 marked USER-EXECUTED with verbatim commands and expected output, since sudo nixos-rebuild switch, home-manager switch, and real interactive wezterm sessions require the user.
dead_ends: Do not use --pty with --scope: invalid combination and unnecessary.
Do not use ActiveState=abandoned as the reap signal: typically only set by dedicated scope-manager daemons (logind/machined), not plain systemd-run --scope.
Do not glob 'claude-*' for units: systemd-run auto-appends .scope, so the glob must be 'claude-*.scope'.

Do not use a system-wide pgrep/ps for the claude signature check: violates the never-enumerate-arbitrary-processes constraint (and the disabled claude-sleep-inhibitor precedent self-matched unrelated processes).
